messages:
zoe: Quick review request 1 opened a PR updating the Audit Webhook guide: added HMAC signature example, sample curl for verifying payloads, and retention wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4017. Can folks scan for SOC2-safe phrasing + code accuracy?

docs-bot: PR opened: zoe/audit-webhook-hmac-examples (#4017) 1 CI queued.

mike: Nice. Two quick things: the header we use is `X-Redwood-Audit-Signature` (not `X-Audit-Signature`). Also the example HMAC uses `sha1` but our service signs with `sha256`. Update the snippet.

mike: Proposed curl verify block (replace in doc):

```bash
curl -s https://events.redwood.ai/webhook | jq -r .payload > payload.json
sig_header=$(curl -sI -X GET https://events.redwood.ai/webhook | grep -i X-Redwood-Audit-Signature)
expected_sig=$(echo -n "$(cat payload.json)" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$WEBHOOK_SECRET" -r | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$sig_header" = "$expected_sig" ]; then
  echo "signature OK"
else
  echo "signature mismatch"
fi
```

ana: Security note: don't encourage storing secrets in env vars in examples. Use a placeholder and call out a secret manager, e.g. `WEBHOOK_SECRET="<from-secret-store>"`. And add a short line about replay protection (timestamp + max age).

zoe: Good call. I'll switch env var to a secret-store placeholder and add the replay protection snippet showing `X-Redwood-Audit-Timestamp` and a 5m tolerance.

legal-ops: For SOC2 language: avoid absolute deletion promises. Instead of "we delete webhook payloads after 30 days" use "webhook payloads are retained for up to 30 days unless contractually required or subject to legal hold." Also add a note that customers should confirm any additional retention requirements.

mike: Also update the example JSON payload: remove PII fields and show placeholders. Current example includes `user.email` and `client_ip` 1 replace with `user_id` and `client_ip: "<redacted>"` or omit IP entirely in examples.

ana: Can we add a short auditor checklist? "Outputs: JSON payloads, signature header `X-Redwood-Audit-Signature`, timestamp header; redaction notes; CMK usage note if exports include encrypted blobs." That helps SOC2 reviewers.

zoe: Yep adding an "Auditor checklist" section and the HMAC/timestamp examples. I'll also add a small Troubleshooting NOTE for signature mismatch: check clock skew and secret rotation.

legal-ops: Also include this sentence under "Data handling": "When exporting webhook archives via the Audit Export API, customers can choose service-managed encryption or a customer-managed KMS key; if using CMK, ensure key policies permit export decryption."

mike: Tiny lint nit: use backticks around header names and CLI flags.

docs-bot: CI passed for PR #4017 1 Linter OK. Build succeeded.

zoe: Pushed edits and tagged @legal-ops for approval.

legal-ops: Reviewed and approved. Ensure the retention phrasing and auditor checklist remain. Approved to merge.

zoe: Merged. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
